source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចថ្លុងដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilience Pomelo Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 17pp
text:
This ASPIRE/IFAD-funded guide sets out pomelo (ក្រូចថ្លុង) growing techniques adapted to a changing, less predictable climate, covering site and soil selection, seedling selection, planting, care, soil and water management, harvest, post-harvest handling, and orchard economics.

As with the general MAFF pomelo manual, suitable soil should be well-drained with a target pH of about 6.5, and planting sites should have dependable access to water and should not be prone to waterlogging, since resilience to climate stress starts with choosing land that already drains and holds water well under normal conditions.
